title: Command Palette Dock does not remember selected Network Adapter
author: mattlaverick-yuga

judgment.rationale: The issue is labeled Resolution-Fix Committed, and a maintainer states that PR #49678 should improve adapter persistence in Command Palette 0.12 / PowerToys 0.101. The remaining work is release verification, not a new design.
evidence: The report gives clear restart steps for a selected network adapter reverting.
The issue has the Resolution-Fix Committed label.
A maintainer links PR #49678 and names the expected shipping versions.
judgment.recommended_action: Verify on PowerToys 0.101 / CmdPal 0.12 or newer and close if adapter selection persists across restart.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR #49678 is publicly identified by a maintainer and the issue is labeled Resolution-Fix Committed.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock forgot the selected network adapter after restart; PR #49678 is expected to fix it in the next stated release.
known_information: The issue affects Performance Stats in the Dock.
The selected adapter changes after restart.
A fix is publicly linked and marked committed.
inferences: The issue can be closed after successful release verification.
issue_context.analysis: This should move through verification rather than return to design triage.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Release verification on PowerToys 0.101 / CmdPal 0.12 or newer.
information_gaps.why_needed: The fix has not been confirmed in the issue thread.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Select a non-default adapter, restart, and confirm it remains selected.

actions.label: Verify committed adapter-persistence fix
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: PR #49678 is expected to address this in Command Palette 0.12 / PowerToys 0.101. Please verify on that release or newer by selecting a non-default network adapter, restarting Windows, and confirming that the same adapter remains selected. If it does, this issue can be closed as fixed; if not, please state the adapter names and attach a fresh `/bugreport`.
